component.name: Photostacker
component.summary: Stack exposure brackets and bursts as layers in one PSD or TIFF

description.p: Photostacker finds the series of one shot in a folder of photos (exposure brackets, HDR sets, fast bursts) and stacks each series as layers in one PSD, PSB or layered TIFF, ready for Photoshop or any editor that reads layers.
It works offline, only reads your photos, and never writes over a file. It is a desktop app and a command-line tool.
